source.title: Daimler Truck and Torc Robotics Select Innoviz Technologies as LiDAR Partner for Series Production of Level 4 Autonomous Trucks

observations: Daimler Truck and Torc selected Innoviz as short-range LiDAR supplier for series-production SAE Level 4 autonomous Class 8 trucks.
InnovizTwo short-range LiDAR is planned for integration into autonomous Freightliner Cascadia with Torc's virtual driver.
This materially clarifies the sensor architecture around Aeva: Aeva's disclosed exclusivity is for long-range LiDAR, while Daimler/Torc separately selected Innoviz for short-range LiDAR.
